title: Niobium Ore
pages: Niobium Ore and Deepslate Niobium Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -48 and 24 (veins of size 4, up to two veins per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Niobium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: containment forge. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/niobium inputs are accepted.

Niobium cannot be smelted or blasted: its oxide stays locked in the ore gangue. The Crusher processes one Raw Niobium into two Niobium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick. A Leaching Vat digests each grit with 500 mB of water into one Niobium Oxide Cake in 180 ticks at 12 energy per tick, and a Kiln held at full 1000 heat reduces each cake into one Niobium Ingot in 260 ticks. Automate by hopper-chaining Crusher output into the Leaching Vat input face, piping water into its tank, and feeding the extracted cakes into the Kiln. Later the Induction Coiler and Reliquary Stand offer higher-yield routes.

Niobium uses forge:ores/niobium, forge:raw_materials/niobium and forge:ingots/niobium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Niobium Ingots are a high-strength material for later apparatus and material progression.
